messages.content: Write a self-contained Python function solve(x). Use the standard library. Return one complete Python code block.

x is a list of [label, value] pairs in arrival order. Labels are short words and values are whole numbers from 0 to 22. Return the labels whose final recorded value is at least 10. List them in the order they first appeared, even when the final observation order differs. Empty input is valid. Write solve(x), returning the result. One example is x = [['red', 10], ['ash', 22], ['red', 1], ['lime', 10], ['ash', 0], ['red', 11]], which gives ['red', 'lime'].
